title: (NEW WR!) Deepest Sword 10x Any% Speedrun in 32:40.769
description: Lets fucking goooooooo! Im so happy I was finally able to get a World Record in some category. Thank you to everyone for the support youve shown me. Hopefully in another 80 hours of runs we can get an Any% 1x record. Also, lets do this Nufuru. A back and forth on the leaderboard would really help this community get some more members.   -- Watch live at https://www.twitch.tv/wrenstreamsmusic
